records.literal_gloss: And came up Shishak king of Egypt against Jerusalem, and he took [the] treasures of [the] house of Yahweh and [the] treasures of [the] house of the king; the all he took; and he took [the] shields of the gold which made Solomon.

en.L: And Shishak king of Egypt came up against Jerusalem, and he took the treasures of the house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} and the treasures of the house of the king; he took everything. And he took the shields of gold that Solomon had made.
en.B: So Shishak king of Egypt came up against Jerusalem. He carried off the treasures of the house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} and those of the king's palace. He took everything, even the gold shields Solomon had made.
en.R: So Shishak, the king of Egypt, attacked Jerusalem. He carried off the treasures from the temple of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} and from the king's palace. He took everything. He even took the gold shields that Solomon had made.

es.L: Y subió Sisac, rey de Egipto, contra Jerusalén, y tomó los tesoros de la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} y los tesoros de la casa del rey; lo tomó todo. Y tomó los escudos de oro que Salomón había hecho.
es.B: Así Sisac, rey de Egipto, subió contra Jerusalén. Se llevó los tesoros de la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} y los del palacio real. Se lo llevó todo, incluso los escudos de oro que Salomón había hecho.
es.R: Así que Sisac, el rey de Egipto, atacó Jerusalén. Se llevó los tesoros del templo {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} y del palacio del rey. Se lo llevó todo. Hasta se llevó los escudos de oro que Salomón había hecho.

fr.L: Et Shishaq, roi d’Égypte, monta contre Jérusalem, et il prit les trésors de la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} et les trésors de la maison du roi ; il prit tout. Et il prit les boucliers d’or que Salomon avait faits.
fr.B: Shishaq, roi d’Égypte, monta donc contre Jérusalem. Il emporta les trésors de la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} et ceux du palais royal. Il prit tout, même les boucliers d’or que Salomon avait faits.
fr.R: Shishaq, le roi d’Égypte, a donc attaqué Jérusalem. Il a emporté les trésors du temple {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} et ceux du palais du roi. Il a tout pris. Il a même pris les boucliers d’or que Salomon avait faits.

sw.L: Shishaki mfalme wa Misri akapanda dhidi ya Yerusalemu, akachukua hazina za nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} na hazina za nyumba ya mfalme; akachukua kila kitu. Akachukua pia ngao za dhahabu alizozitengeneza Sulemani.
sw.B: Basi Shishaki mfalme wa Misri alipanda kuushambulia Yerusalemu. Alichukua hazina za nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} na za ikulu ya mfalme. Alichukua kila kitu, hata ngao za dhahabu alizotengeneza Sulemani.
sw.R: Basi Shishaki, mfalme wa Misri, aliushambulia Yerusalemu. Alichukua hazina za hekalu la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} na za ikulu ya mfalme. Alichukua kila kitu. Hata alichukua ngao za dhahabu ambazo Sulemani alikuwa amezitengeneza.

vi.L: Si-sắc vua Ai Cập đi lên đánh Giê-ru-sa-lem, và ông lấy các kho báu của nhà {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} và các kho báu của nhà vua; ông lấy tất cả. Ông cũng lấy các khiên bằng vàng mà Sa-lô-môn đã làm.
vi.B: Vậy Si-sắc vua Ai Cập đi lên đánh Giê-ru-sa-lem. Vua ấy lấy đi các kho báu của nhà {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} và của cung vua. Vua lấy hết mọi thứ, kể cả các khiên vàng Sa-lô-môn đã làm.
vi.R: Vậy Si-sắc, vua Ai Cập, tấn công Giê-ru-sa-lem. Vua ấy lấy đi các kho báu trong đền thờ của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} và trong cung vua. Vua lấy hết mọi thứ. Vua còn lấy các khiên vàng mà Sa-lô-môn đã làm.

ko.L: 그리고 이집트 왕 시삭이 예루살렘을 치러 올라와서, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 집의 보물들과 왕의 집의 보물들을 가져갔다. 그가 모든 것을 가져갔다. 그리고 그는 솔로몬이 만든 금 방패들을 가져갔다.
ko.B: 이집트 왕 시삭은 예루살렘을 치러 올라와서, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 집에 있는 보물들과 왕궁에 있는 보물들을 빼앗아 갔다. 그는 모든 것을 가져갔고, 솔로몬이 만든 금 방패들까지 가져갔다.
ko.R: 이집트 왕 시삭은 예루살렘을 공격했다. 그는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 성전과 왕궁에 있던 보물들을 빼앗아 갔다. 그는 모든 것을 가져갔다. 솔로몬이 만든 금 방패들까지 가져갔다.

pt.L: E Sisaque, rei do Egito, subiu contra Jerusalém, e tomou os tesouros da casa {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} e os tesouros da casa do rei; tomou tudo. E tomou os escudos de ouro que Salomão tinha feito.
pt.B: Assim Sisaque, rei do Egito, subiu contra Jerusalém. Ele levou os tesouros da casa {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} e os do palácio do rei. Levou tudo, até os escudos de ouro que Salomão tinha feito.
pt.R: Assim Sisaque, o rei do Egito, atacou Jerusalém. Ele levou os tesouros do templo {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} e do palácio do rei. Levou tudo. Levou até os escudos de ouro que Salomão tinha feito.

decisions.choice: the same words as 1 Kings 14:25-26, with two small differences
decisions.reason: Chronicles repeats the opening of 1 Kings 14:25 ("Shishak king of Egypt came up against Jerusalem") to return to the story after Shemaiah's message, and then follows 1 Kings 14:26. Kings says "all the shields of gold"; Chronicles has "the shields of gold" without "all". The sense is the same.

decisions.choice: the shields of gold that Solomon had made: the display shields of 9:15-16
decisions.reason: Solomon made two hundred large shields and three hundred small ones of hammered gold for the House of the Forest of Lebanon (9:15-16; 1 Kings 10:16-17). Now they are gone. The treasure of the temple and the palace is what the servitude of verse 8 costs.

decisions.choice: he took everything: the plunder was complete
decisions.reason: "Everything" stands first for emphasis, as in 1 Kings 14:26.

decisions.choice: the king's palace (Balanced, Readable); the temple (Readable)
decisions.reason: As in 1 Kings 14:26: the same Hebrew word "house" is used for the king's palace and for Yahweh's temple. "So" at the start marks the return to the story of verses 2-4.

decisions.choice: the wording of 1 Kings 14:25-26; os escudos de ouro
decisions.reason: The opening repeats 1 Kings 14:25 and the rest follows 1 Kings 14:26 in Portuguese level by level (m1), without Kings' "todos" before "os escudos de ouro", which Chronicles lacks.

source.text: וַיַּ֨עַשׂ הַמֶּ֤לֶךְ רְחַבְעָם֙ תַּחְתֵּיהֶ֔ם מָגִנֵּ֖י נְחֹ֑שֶׁת וְהִפְקִ֗יד עַל־יַד֙ שָׂרֵ֣י הָרָצִ֔ים הַשֹּׁ֣מְרִ֔ים פֶּ֖תַח בֵּ֥ית הַמֶּֽלֶךְ׃

records.literal_gloss: And made King Rehoboam in their place shields of bronze, and he entrusted [them] on [the] hand of [the] commanders of the runners, the ones keeping [the] entrance of [the] house of the king.

en.L: And King Rehoboam made in their place shields of bronze, and he entrusted [them] to the hand of the commanders of the runners, who kept the entrance of the house of the king.
en.B: King Rehoboam made bronze shields to replace them and entrusted them to the commanders of the guard who kept watch at the entrance of the king's palace.
en.R: So King Rehoboam made shields of bronze to take their place. He put them in the care of the commanders of the guard, the soldiers who guarded the entrance to the king's palace.

es.L: E hizo el rey Roboam en su lugar escudos de bronce, y [los] confió a la mano de los jefes de los corredores, que guardaban la entrada de la casa del rey.
es.B: El rey Roboam hizo escudos de bronce para reemplazarlos y los confió a los jefes de la guardia que vigilaban la entrada del palacio real.
es.R: Así que el rey Roboam hizo escudos de bronce para ponerlos en su lugar. Los dejó al cuidado de los jefes de la guardia, los soldados que vigilaban la entrada del palacio del rey.

fr.L: Et le roi Roboam fit à leur place des boucliers de bronze, et il [les] confia à la main des chefs des coureurs qui gardaient l’entrée de la maison du roi.
fr.B: Le roi Roboam fit des boucliers de bronze pour les remplacer et les confia aux chefs de la garde qui veillaient à l’entrée du palais royal.
fr.R: Alors le roi Roboam a fait des boucliers de bronze pour les remplacer. Il les a confiés aux chefs de la garde, les soldats qui surveillaient l’entrée du palais du roi.

sw.L: Mfalme Rehoboamu akatengeneza mahali pake ngao za shaba, akazikabidhi mkononi mwa wakuu wa matarishi, waliolinda mlango wa nyumba ya mfalme.
sw.B: Mfalme Rehoboamu akatengeneza ngao za shaba badala yake, akawakabidhi wakuu wa walinzi waliolinda lango la ikulu ya mfalme.
sw.R: Basi mfalme Rehoboamu akatengeneza ngao za shaba badala ya zile. Akaziweka chini ya uangalizi wa wakuu wa walinzi, askari waliolinda lango la ikulu ya mfalme.

vi.L: Vua Rô-bô-am làm các khiên bằng đồng thay vào đó, và giao [chúng] vào tay các viên chỉ huy những người chạy hầu, là những người canh giữ cổng nhà vua.
vi.B: Vua Rô-bô-am làm các khiên bằng đồng để thay thế, và giao cho các viên chỉ huy đội thị vệ canh giữ cổng cung vua.
vi.R: Vì vậy vua Rô-bô-am làm các khiên bằng đồng để thay vào. Vua giao các khiên ấy cho các viên chỉ huy đội thị vệ, là những người lính canh giữ cổng cung vua.

ko.L: 그리고 르호보암 왕이 그것들 대신 놋 방패들을 만들어, 왕의 집 입구를 지키는 달리는 자들의 지휘관들의 손에 맡겼다.
ko.B: 르호보암 왕은 그 대신 놋 방패들을 만들어, 왕궁 입구를 지키는 호위대 지휘관들에게 맡겼다.
ko.R: 그래서 르호보암 왕은 그것들 대신 놋으로 방패들을 만들었다. 그리고 그 방패들을 호위대 지휘관들에게 맡겼다. 그들은 왕궁 입구를 지키는 군인들이었다.

pt.L: E o rei Roboão fez em lugar deles escudos de bronze, e [os] confiou à mão dos chefes dos corredores, que guardavam a entrada da casa do rei.
pt.B: O rei Roboão fez escudos de bronze para substituí-los e os confiou aos chefes da guarda que vigiavam a entrada do palácio real.
pt.R: Então o rei Roboão fez escudos de bronze para pôr no lugar deles. Ele os entregou aos chefes da guarda, os soldados que vigiavam a entrada do palácio do rei.

decisions.choice: the same words as 1 Kings 14:27
decisions.reason: The verse repeats 1 Kings 14:27; only the spelling of "in their place" differs slightly. Bronze takes the place of gold: the court keeps up the show, but the splendor of Solomon's reign is gone.

decisions.choice: the runners: the king's guard
decisions.reason: As in 1 Kings 14:27: the "runners" were royal guards who ran before the king's chariot and kept watch at his palace (1 Samuel 22:17; 2 Samuel 15:1).

decisions.choice: the runners (Literal); the guard (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: Worded as in 1 Kings 14:27. "Commanders" is kept at every level, as for military leaders elsewhere.

decisions.choice: "los corredores" (L); "la guardia" (B, R)
decisions.reason: As the English (r-en-1) and the Spanish of 1 Kings 14:27: the runners are the king's guard.

decisions.choice: matarishi (Literal); walinzi (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: The royal "runners" are "matarishi" at Literal and the guard at Balanced and Readable, as the Swahili 1 Kings 14:27.

decisions.choice: "달리는 자들" (L), "호위대" (B, R)
decisions.reason: As 1 Kings 14:27 and the Korean Kings.

decisions.choice: the wording of 1 Kings 14:27; os corredores (L), a guarda (B, R)
decisions.reason: The verse repeats 1 Kings 14:27 (m1), so each level keeps Kings' Portuguese, with the royal runners as "corredores" at Literal and "a guarda" at Balanced and Readable (m2).

source.text: וַיְהִ֛י מִדֵּי־ב֥וֹא הַמֶּ֖לֶךְ בֵּ֣ית יְהוָ֑ה בָּ֤אוּ הָרָצִים֙ וּנְשָׂא֔וּם וֶהֱשִׁב֖וּם אֶל־תָּ֥א הָרָצִֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: And it was as often as went the king [into the] house of Yahweh, came the runners and carried them, and returned them to [the] guardroom of the runners.

en.L: And it happened, as often as the king went into the house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, the runners came and carried them, and they brought them back to the guardroom of the runners.
en.B: Whenever the king went into the house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, the guards came and carried the shields, and afterward they brought them back to the guardroom.
en.R: Every time the king went to the temple of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, the guards came and carried the shields in front of him. Then they took them back to the guards' room.

es.L: Y sucedía que, cada vez que el rey entraba en la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, venían los corredores y los llevaban, y luego los devolvían a la sala de guardia de los corredores.
es.B: Cada vez que el rey entraba en la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, venían los guardias y llevaban los escudos, y después los devolvían a la sala de guardia.
es.R: Cada vez que el rey iba al templo {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, venían los guardias y llevaban los escudos delante de él. Después los llevaban de vuelta al cuarto de los guardias.

fr.L: Et il arrivait, chaque fois que le roi entrait dans la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, que les coureurs venaient et les portaient, puis ils les rapportaient dans la salle des coureurs.
fr.B: Chaque fois que le roi entrait dans la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, les gardes venaient porter les boucliers, puis ils les rapportaient dans la salle de garde.
fr.R: Chaque fois que le roi allait au temple {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, les gardes venaient et portaient les boucliers devant lui. Ensuite ils les rapportaient dans la salle des gardes.

sw.L: Ikawa, kila mara mfalme alipoingia nyumbani mwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, matarishi walikuja wakazichukua, kisha wakazirudisha katika chumba cha matarishi.
sw.B: Kila mara mfalme alipoingia nyumbani mwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, walinzi walikuja wakazibeba ngao hizo, kisha wakazirudisha katika chumba cha walinzi.
sw.R: Kila mara mfalme alipokwenda hekaluni mwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, walinzi walikuja na kuzibeba ngao hizo mbele yake. Kisha wakazirudisha katika chumba cha walinzi.

vi.L: Xảy ra, mỗi lần vua vào nhà {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, những người chạy hầu đến mang chúng, rồi đem chúng trở về phòng của những người chạy hầu.
vi.B: Mỗi khi vua vào nhà {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, quân thị vệ đến mang các khiên ấy, rồi đem trả về phòng thị vệ.
vi.R: Mỗi lần vua đến đền thờ của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, quân thị vệ đến mang các khiên ấy đi trước vua. Sau đó họ đem các khiên về cất trong phòng lính gác.

ko.L: 그리고 왕이 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 집에 들어갈 때마다 달리는 자들이 와서 그것들을 들었고, 그것들을 달리는 자들의 방으로 다시 가져갔다.
ko.B: 왕이 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 집에 들어갈 때마다 호위병들이 와서 그 방패들을 들고 갔다가, 다시 호위병 방에 가져다 두었다.
ko.R: 왕이 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 성전에 갈 때마다 호위병들이 와서 그 방패들을 들고 왕 앞에서 걸어갔다. 그리고 그 방패들을 다시 호위병들의 방에 가져다 두었다.

pt.L: E acontecia que, todas as vezes que o rei entrava na casa {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, os corredores vinham e os carregavam, e os traziam de volta à sala dos corredores.
pt.B: Sempre que o rei entrava na casa {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, os guardas vinham e carregavam os escudos, e depois os levavam de volta à sala da guarda.
pt.R: Toda vez que o rei ia ao templo {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, os guardas vinham e carregavam os escudos na frente dele. Depois eles os levavam de volta para a sala dos guardas.

decisions.choice: the same words as 1 Kings 14:28, with "came" added
decisions.reason: 1 Kings 14:28 says "the runners carried them"; Chronicles says "the runners came and carried them". The sense is the same: the guards came out for the procession.

decisions.choice: carried them and brought them back: the shields were for ceremony
decisions.reason: As in 1 Kings 14:28: the shields were carried in procession when the king went up to the temple and then stored in the guardroom. They were for display, not for battle.

decisions.choice: the runners (Literal); the guards (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: As in verse 10. Balanced does not repeat "of the guards" after "guardroom".

decisions.choice: in front of him (Readable)
decisions.reason: Readable shows that the shields were carried in procession before the king (m2), as in 1 Kings 14:28.

decisions.choice: vinham e carregavam
decisions.reason: As 1 Kings 14:28 in Portuguese, with "vinham" added at every level where Chronicles adds "came" (m1).

source.text: וּבְהִכָּֽנְע֗וֹ שָׁ֤ב מִמֶּ֨נּוּ֙ אַף־יְהוָ֔ה וְלֹ֥א לְהַשְׁחִ֖ית לְכָלָ֑ה וְגַם֙ בִּֽיהוּדָ֔ה הָיָ֖ה דְּבָרִ֥ים טוֹבִֽים׃ס

records.literal_gloss: And when he humbled himself, turned from him [the] anger of Yahweh, and not to destroy to completion; and also in Judah there were things good.

en.L: And when he humbled himself, the anger of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} turned from him, and [it was] not to destroy [him] completely; and also in Judah there were good things.
en.B: Because he humbled himself, the anger of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} turned back from him and did not destroy him completely. And there were also good things in Judah.
en.R: Rehoboam humbled himself, so {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} stopped being angry with him and did not destroy him completely. Also, some good things were still found in Judah.

es.L: Y cuando él se humilló, la ira {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} se apartó de él, y no [fue] para destruir[lo] del todo; y también en Judá había cosas buenas.
es.B: Como se humilló, la ira {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} se apartó de él y no lo destruyó por completo. Además, en Judá había también cosas buenas.
es.R: Roboam se humilló, así que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} dejó de estar enojado con él y no lo destruyó por completo. Además, todavía se hallaban algunas cosas buenas en Judá.

fr.L: Et quand il s’humilia, la colère {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} se détourna de lui, et [ce ne fut] pas pour [le] détruire entièrement ; et aussi en Juda il y avait de bonnes choses.
fr.B: Parce qu’il s’était humilié, la colère {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} se détourna de lui, et elle ne le détruisit pas entièrement. Et il y avait aussi de bonnes choses en Juda.
fr.R: Roboam s’est humilié, alors {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} n’a plus été en colère contre lui et ne l’a pas détruit complètement. De plus, on trouvait encore de bonnes choses en Juda.

sw.L: Alipojinyenyekeza, hasira ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ikageuka mbali naye, wala [haikuwa] ya kumwangamiza kabisa; tena katika Yuda kulikuwa na mambo mema.
sw.B: Kwa sababu alijinyenyekeza, hasira ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} iligeuka mbali naye, wala haikumwangamiza kabisa. Tena kulikuwa na mambo mema katika Yuda.
sw.R: Rehoboamu alijinyenyekeza, kwa hiyo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aliacha kumkasirikia, wala hakumwangamiza kabisa. Tena mambo mema yalikuwa bado yanapatikana katika Yuda.

vi.L: Khi ông hạ mình xuống, cơn giận của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} quay khỏi ông, và [Ngài] không tiêu diệt [ông] hoàn toàn; tại Giu-đa cũng còn có những điều tốt lành.
vi.B: Vì ông hạ mình xuống, cơn giận của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} quay khỏi ông và không tiêu diệt ông hoàn toàn. Tại Giu-đa cũng còn có những điều tốt lành.
vi.R: Rô-bô-am hạ mình xuống, nên {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} thôi giận ông và không tiêu diệt ông hoàn toàn. Tại Giu-đa vẫn còn thấy có những điều tốt lành.

ko.L: 그리고 그가 스스로 낮추었을 때에 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 분노가 그에게서 돌아섰고, 완전히 멸하지 않으셨다. 그리고 유다에도 선한 일들이 있었다.
ko.B: 그가 스스로 낮추었기 때문에 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 분노가 그에게서 돌아섰고, 그를 완전히 멸하지 않으셨다. 유다에도 좋은 일들이 있었다.
ko.R: 르호보암이 겸손해졌기 때문에 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서는 그에게 노하시던 것을 멈추시고, 그를 완전히 멸하지 않으셨다. 그리고 유다에는 아직 좋은 일들도 남아 있었다.

pt.L: E quando ele se humilhou, a ira {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} se desviou dele, e [não foi] para [o] destruir completamente; e também em Judá havia coisas boas.
pt.B: Porque ele se humilhou, a ira {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} se afastou dele e não o destruiu completamente. E também havia coisas boas em Judá.
pt.R: Roboão se humilhou, e por isso {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} deixou de estar irado com ele e não o destruiu completamente. Além disso, ainda se achavam algumas coisas boas em Judá.

decisions.choice: when he humbled himself, Yahweh's anger turned: the lesson of the story
decisions.reason: The writer sums up the story: humbling oneself before Yahweh turns his anger away (verses 6-7; 7:14). Judah was punished, but not destroyed.

decisions.choice: good things in Judah: some good was still found there
decisions.reason: The phrase may mean that some faithfulness was still found in Judah, which is how the same words are used in 19:3. It may also mean that things went well in Judah after the danger had passed. The first fits the reason given in this verse for sparing the kingdom.

decisions.choice: and not to destroy completely: the anger stopped short of full destruction
decisions.reason: The verb has no stated subject. It describes what the turning of Yahweh's anger meant: Judah was not wiped out (compare verse 7).

decisions.choice: did not destroy him completely (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable make Yahweh's anger, or Yahweh, the subject of "destroy" and supply "him", so the clause reads as a complete sentence (m3).

decisions.choice: were still found (Readable)
decisions.reason: Readable expresses the reading chosen in m2 with words from 19:3.

decisions.choice: ainda se achavam algumas coisas boas
alternatives: as coisas iam bem em Judá
decisions.reason: Readable follows the reading of m2, that some faithfulness was still found in Judah, as the English does; "as coisas iam bem" would give the other reading.

source.text: וַיִּתְחַזֵּ֞ק הַמֶּ֧לֶךְ רְחַבְעָ֛ם בִּירוּשָׁלִַ֖ם וַיִּמְלֹ֑ךְ כִּ֣י בֶן־אַרְבָּעִ֣ים וְאַחַ֣ת שָׁנָה֩ רְחַבְעָ֨ם בְּמָלְכ֜וֹ וּֽשֲׁבַ֨ע עֶשְׂרֵ֥ה שָׁנָ֣ה׀מָלַ֣ךְ בִּֽירוּשָׁלִַ֗ם הָ֠עִיר אֲשֶׁר־בָּחַ֨ר יְהוָ֜ה לָשׂ֨וּם אֶת־שְׁמ֥וֹ שָׁם֙ מִכֹּל֙ שִׁבְטֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְשֵׁ֣ם אִמּ֔וֹ נַעֲמָ֖ה הָֽעַמֹּנִֽית׃

records.literal_gloss: And strengthened himself King Rehoboam in Jerusalem and reigned; for a son of forty and one year[s was] Rehoboam in his reigning, and seventeen year[s] he reigned in Jerusalem, the city which chose Yahweh to put his name there from all [the] tribes of Israel; and [the] name of his mother [was] Naamah the Ammonite.

en.L: And King Rehoboam strengthened himself in Jerusalem and reigned. For Rehoboam [was] a son of forty-one years when he became king, and he reigned seventeen years in Jerusalem, the city that {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} had chosen out of all the tribes of Israel to put {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} name there. And the name of his mother [was] Naamah the Ammonite.
en.B: King Rehoboam established himself firmly in Jerusalem and reigned. Rehoboam was forty-one years old when he became king, and he reigned seventeen years in Jerusalem, the city {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} had chosen from among all the tribes of Israel as the place for {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} name. His mother's name was Naamah the Ammonite.
en.R: King Rehoboam made his rule strong in Jerusalem and went on as king. He became king at the age of forty-one, and he ruled for seventeen years in Jerusalem. Out of all the tribes of Israel, {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} had chosen this city as the place where {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} would be worshiped. Rehoboam's mother's name was Naamah the Ammonite.

es.L: Y se fortaleció el rey Roboam en Jerusalén, y reinó. Hijo de cuarenta y un años [era] Roboam cuando comenzó a reinar, y reinó diecisiete años en Jerusalén, la ciudad que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} había escogido de entre todas las tribus de Israel para poner allí {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} nombre. Y el nombre de su madre [era] Naama la amonita.
es.B: El rey Roboam se afirmó en Jerusalén y siguió reinando. Roboam tenía cuarenta y un años cuando comenzó a reinar, y reinó diecisiete años en Jerusalén, la ciudad que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} había escogido de entre todas las tribus de Israel como lugar para {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} nombre. Su madre se llamaba Naama la amonita.
es.R: El rey Roboam hizo fuerte su gobierno en Jerusalén y siguió siendo rey. Tenía cuarenta y un años cuando comenzó a reinar, y reinó diecisiete años en Jerusalén. De entre todas las tribus de Israel, {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} había escogido esa ciudad como el lugar donde {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} sería adorado. La madre de Roboam se llamaba Naama la amonita.

fr.L: Et le roi Roboam s’affermit à Jérusalem et régna. Car Roboam [était] fils de quarante et un ans quand il devint roi, et il régna dix-sept ans à Jérusalem, la ville que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} avait choisie parmi toutes les tribus d’Israël pour y mettre {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} nom. Et le nom de sa mère [était] Naama l’Ammonite.
fr.B: Le roi Roboam s’affermit à Jérusalem et régna. Roboam avait quarante et un ans quand il devint roi, et il régna dix-sept ans à Jérusalem, la ville que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} avait choisie parmi toutes les tribus d’Israël pour y mettre {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} nom. Sa mère s’appelait Naama l’Ammonite.
fr.R: Le roi Roboam a rendu son pouvoir solide à Jérusalem et il a continué à régner. Il avait quarante et un ans quand il est devenu roi, et il a régné dix-sept ans à Jérusalem. Parmi toutes les tribus d’Israël, {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} avait choisi cette ville comme le lieu où on {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}adorerait. La mère de Roboam s’appelait Naama l’Ammonite.

sw.L: Mfalme Rehoboamu akajiimarisha huko Yerusalemu, akatawala. Kwa maana Rehoboamu [alikuwa] mwana wa miaka arobaini na mmoja alipoanza kutawala, akatawala miaka kumi na saba huko Yerusalemu, mji ambao {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aliuchagua kutoka katika makabila yote ya Israeli ili kuweka jina {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}} huko. Na jina la mama yake [lilikuwa] Naama Mwamoni.
sw.B: Mfalme Rehoboamu alijiimarisha huko Yerusalemu, akaendelea kutawala. Rehoboamu alikuwa na umri wa miaka arobaini na mmoja alipoanza kutawala, naye akatawala miaka kumi na saba huko Yerusalemu, mji ambao {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aliuchagua kati ya makabila yote ya Israeli kuwa mahali pa jina {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}}. Mama yake aliitwa Naama Mwamoni.
sw.R: Mfalme Rehoboamu aliufanya utawala wake kuwa imara huko Yerusalemu, akaendelea kuwa mfalme. Alikuwa na umri wa miaka arobaini na mmoja alipoanza kutawala, naye akatawala miaka kumi na saba huko Yerusalemu. Kati ya makabila yote ya Israeli, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alikuwa ameuchagua mji huu kuwa mahali ambapo angeabudiwa. Mama yake Rehoboamu aliitwa Naama Mwamoni.

vi.L: Vua Rô-bô-am làm cho mình vững mạnh tại Giê-ru-sa-lem và trị vì. Vì Rô-bô-am [là] người bốn mươi mốt tuổi khi lên làm vua, và ông trị vì mười bảy năm tại Giê-ru-sa-lem, là thành {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã chọn trong tất cả các chi tộc Y-sơ-ra-ên để đặt danh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} tại đó. Tên mẹ ông [là] Na-a-ma, người Am-môn.
vi.B: Vua Rô-bô-am củng cố vững chắc quyền cai trị tại Giê-ru-sa-lem và tiếp tục trị vì. Rô-bô-am được bốn mươi mốt tuổi khi lên làm vua và trị vì mười bảy năm tại Giê-ru-sa-lem, là thành {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã chọn trong tất cả các chi tộc Y-sơ-ra-ên để làm nơi đặt danh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. Mẹ vua tên là Na-a-ma, người Am-môn.
vi.R: Vua Rô-bô-am làm cho quyền cai trị của mình tại Giê-ru-sa-lem được vững mạnh và tiếp tục làm vua. Ông được bốn mươi mốt tuổi khi lên làm vua và trị vì mười bảy năm tại Giê-ru-sa-lem. Trong tất cả các chi tộc Y-sơ-ra-ên, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã chọn thành này làm nơi người ta thờ phượng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. Mẹ vua tên là Na-a-ma, người Am-môn.

ko.L: 그리고 르호보암 왕이 예루살렘에서 자신을 강하게 하여 다스렸다. 르호보암은 왕이 될 때 41세였고, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 그분의 이름을 두시려고 이스라엘 모든 지파 가운데서 택하신 성읍 예루살렘에서 17년 동안 다스렸다. 그리고 그의 어머니의 이름은 암몬 사람 나아마였다.
ko.B: 르호보암 왕은 예루살렘에서 자기 자리를 굳게 하고 다스렸다. 르호보암은 41세에 왕이 되어 예루살렘에서 17년 동안 다스렸다. 예루살렘은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 자신의 이름을 두시려고 이스라엘 모든 지파 가운데서 택하신 성읍이다. 그의 어머니의 이름은 암몬 사람 나아마였다.
ko.R: 르호보암 왕은 예루살렘에서 자기 다스림을 든든히 하고 계속 왕으로 있었다. 그는 41세에 왕이 되어 예루살렘에서 17년 동안 다스렸다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서는 이스라엘의 모든 지파 가운데서 이 성읍을 택하시고, 그곳에서 예배를 받기로 하셨다. 르호보암의 어머니의 이름은 암몬 사람 나아마였다.

pt.L: E o rei Roboão se fortaleceu em Jerusalém e reinou. Porque Roboão [tinha] quarenta e um anos quando começou a reinar, e reinou dezessete anos em Jerusalém, a cidade que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} tinha escolhido dentre todas as tribos de Israel para pôr ali o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} nome. E o nome da sua mãe [era] Naamá, a amonita.
pt.B: O rei Roboão se firmou em Jerusalém e reinou. Roboão tinha quarenta e um anos quando começou a reinar, e reinou dezessete anos em Jerusalém, a cidade que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} tinha escolhido dentre todas as tribos de Israel para pôr ali o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} nome. A sua mãe se chamava Naamá, a amonita.
pt.R: O rei Roboão tornou forte o seu governo em Jerusalém e continuou como rei. Ele tinha quarenta e um anos quando se tornou rei, e governou dezessete anos em Jerusalém. Dentre todas as tribos de Israel, {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} tinha escolhido essa cidade como o lugar onde {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} seria adorado. A mãe de Roboão se chamava Naamá, a amonita.

decisions.choice: the opening formula of 1 Kings 14:21, placed at the end of the reign
decisions.reason: From "Rehoboam was forty-one" on, the verse repeats 1 Kings 14:21 word for word (see the notes there on the formula, the queen mother Naamah and the city Yahweh chose). Chronicles places it near the close of the reign and opens with a new clause: Rehoboam "strengthened himself in Jerusalem and reigned", that is, his rule recovered after Shishak's attack. The word "for" ties the formula to that clause.

decisions.choice: his mother was Naamah the Ammonite: the queen mother
decisions.reason: Kings and Chronicles name the mothers of the kings of Judah, who held a place of honor at court. Naamah came from Ammon, east of the Jordan.

decisions.choice: a son of forty-one years: forty-one years old
decisions.reason: Hebrew gives a person's age as being "a son of" so many years.

decisions.choice: established himself firmly and reigned (Balanced); made his rule strong and went on as king (Readable)
decisions.reason: The rest of the verse keeps the wording of 1 Kings 14:21 at each level. Readable states the meaning of "to put his name there" as the place where Yahweh would be worshiped, as there.

decisions.choice: the accession formula of the Kings terms note
decisions.reason: "Hijo de cuarenta y un años [era]" (L), "tenía cuarenta y un años cuando comenzó a reinar" (B, R) and "Su madre se llamaba", as the Spanish of 1 Kings 14:21, which this verse repeats.

decisions.choice: "Il avait N ans quand il devint roi, et il régna N ans à Jérusalem" (R "est devenu ... a régné"); "Le nom de sa mère [était]" (L), "Sa mère s'appelait" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The accession and mother formulas of the terms note, as in French Kings (1 Kings 14:21); Literal keeps "fils de quarante et un ans" there as Kings does.

decisions.choice: [alikuwa] mwana wa miaka ... alipoanza kutawala (Literal); alikuwa na umri wa miaka ... (Balanced, Readable); Na jina la mama yake [lilikuwa] (Literal); Mama yake aliitwa (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: The accession and mother formulas of the terms note, worded as in the Swahili 1 Kings 14:21.

decisions.choice: the accession and mother formulas of the terms note, as 1 Kings 14:21
decisions.reason: "X được N tuổi khi lên làm vua và trị vì N năm tại Giê-ru-sa-lem"; "Mẹ vua tên là ..." (B, R), Literal keeping "Tên mẹ ông [là]" as Kings. Chronicles places the formula at the end of the reign (m1).

decisions.choice: The accession formula of the terms note: "41세에 왕이 되어 ... 17년 동안 다스렸다"; "그의 어머니의 이름은 ...였다"; ages and years in figures
decisions.reason: As 1 Kings 14:21, whose words this verse repeats (m1).

decisions.choice: the accession formula of 1 Kings 14:21; se fortaleceu (L), se firmou (B), tornou forte o seu governo (R)
decisions.reason: From "Roboão [tinha] quarenta e um anos" on, the verse is 1 Kings 14:21 in Portuguese word for word at each level, the book's accession formula (m1). Chronicles' own opening replaces Kings' "Roboão, filho de Salomão, reinou em Judá", and Literal keeps its "Porque".

source.text: וַיַּ֖עַשׂ הָרָ֑ע כִּ֣י לֹ֤א הֵכִין֙ לִבּ֔וֹ לִדְר֖וֹשׁ אֶת־יְהוָֽה׃ס

records.literal_gloss: And he did the evil, for not he set his heart to seek Yahweh.

en.L: And he did the evil, for he did not set his heart to seek {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.B: He did what was evil, because he had not set his heart on seeking {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.R: Rehoboam did what was evil. He did not make up his mind to seek {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.

es.L: E hizo lo malo, porque no dispuso su corazón para buscar {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}.
es.B: Hizo lo malo, porque no había dispuesto su corazón para buscar {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}.
es.R: Roboam hizo lo malo. No decidió buscar {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}.

fr.L: Et il fit le mal, car il n’appliqua pas son cœur à rechercher {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.B: Il fit ce qui est mal, car il n’avait pas eu à cœur de rechercher {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.R: Roboam a fait ce qui est mal. Il n’a pas décidé de chercher {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.

sw.L: Akafanya maovu, kwa maana hakuuelekeza moyo wake kumtafuta {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.B: Alifanya maovu, kwa sababu hakuwa ameuelekeza moyo wake kumtafuta {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.R: Rehoboamu alifanya maovu. Hakuamua kumtafuta {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} kwa moyo wake.

vi.L: Ông làm điều ác, vì ông không quyết lòng tìm cầu {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.
vi.B: Ông làm điều ác, vì ông đã không quyết lòng tìm cầu {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.
vi.R: Rô-bô-am làm điều ác. Ông đã không quyết lòng tìm cầu {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.

ko.L: 그리고 그가 악한 일을 했다. 그가 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 찾으려고 마음을 정하지 않았기 때문이다.
ko.B: 그는 악한 일을 했다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 찾는 일에 마음을 쏟지 않았기 때문이다.
ko.R: 르호보암은 악한 일을 했다. 그는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 찾기로 마음먹지 않았다.

pt.L: E ele fez o mal, porque não dispôs o seu coração a buscar {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}.
pt.B: Ele fez o que era mau, porque não tinha disposto o seu coração a buscar {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}.
pt.R: Roboão fez o que era mau. Ele não se decidiu a buscar {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}.

decisions.choice: he did evil: the verdict of 1 Kings 14:22, changed
decisions.reason: 1 Kings 14:22 says that Judah "did the evil in the eyes of Yahweh" and lists the people's sins. Chronicles names Rehoboam himself, leaves out "in the eyes of Yahweh", and gives the reason in its own words: he did not set his heart to seek Yahweh.

decisions.choice: set his heart to seek Yahweh: the measure of a king in Chronicles
decisions.reason: To "seek" Yahweh in Chronicles is to turn to him in worship, prayer and obedience (1 Chronicles 22:19; 2 Chronicles 7:14; 15:12). "Set the heart" means to fix one's will on it. The verb "set" is the one used in verse 1 for the kingdom being "established": Rehoboam made his kingdom firm but not his heart.

decisions.choice: did what was evil (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew does not say "in the sight of the LORD" here, so the usual verdict wording is shortened. Readable drops "because" and lets the second sentence give the reason.

decisions.choice: "hizo lo malo"
alternatives: hizo lo malo a los ojos del SEÑOR
decisions.reason: Chronicles has "did evil" without "in the eyes of Yahweh" (meaning decision), so the verdict formula of the terms note is shortened here as the Hebrew is.

decisions.choice: "làm điều ác" without "trước mắt CHÚA"
decisions.reason: The Hebrew does not add "in the sight of the LORD" here (m1), so the verdict formula is shortened at every level.

decisions.choice: fez o mal (L), fez o que era mau (B, R), without "aos olhos do SENHOR"
alternatives: fez o que era mau aos olhos do SENHOR
decisions.reason: The verdict keeps the words of 1 Kings 14:22 in Portuguese, shortened as Chronicles shortens it (m1): no "aos olhos do SENHOR". "Dispor o coração a buscar o SENHOR" is the phrase of 11:16 (m2).

source.text: וְדִבְרֵ֣י רְחַבְעָ֗ם הָרִאשֹׁנִים֙ וְהָאֲ֣חַרוֹנִ֔ים הֲלֹא־הֵ֨ם כְּתוּבִ֜ים בְּדִבְרֵ֨י שְׁמַֽעְיָ֧ה הַנָּבִ֛יא וְעִדּ֥וֹ הַחֹזֶ֖ה לְהִתְיַחֵ֑שׂ וּמִלְחֲמ֧וֹת רְחַבְעָ֛ם וְיָרָבְעָ֖ם כָּל־הַיָּמִֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: And [the] matters of Rehoboam, the first and the last, [are] not they written in [the] words of Shemaiah the prophet and Iddo the seer, for enrolling by genealogy? And [the] wars of Rehoboam and Jeroboam [were] all the days.

en.L: And the matters of Rehoboam, the first and the last, are they not written in the words of Shemaiah the prophet and of Iddo the seer, for genealogical enrollment? And [there were] wars of Rehoboam and Jeroboam all the days.
en.B: The acts of Rehoboam, from first to last, are written in the records of Shemaiah the prophet and of Iddo the seer, in the genealogical records. There were wars between Rehoboam and Jeroboam continually.
en.R: Everything Rehoboam did, from beginning to end, is written in the records of Shemaiah the prophet and Iddo the seer, in the family records. (A seer was a prophet who received messages from God.) Rehoboam and Jeroboam were always at war with each other.

es.L: Y los hechos de Roboam, los primeros y los postreros, ¿no están escritos en las palabras del profeta Semaías y de Ido el vidente, para el registro genealógico? Y [hubo] guerras entre Roboam y Jeroboam todos los días.
es.B: Los hechos de Roboam, desde el primero hasta el último, están escritos en los registros del profeta Semaías y de Ido el vidente, en los registros genealógicos. Hubo guerras entre Roboam y Jeroboam continuamente.
es.R: Todo lo que hizo Roboam, desde el principio hasta el fin, está escrito en los registros del profeta Semaías y de Ido el vidente, en los registros de las familias. (Un vidente era un profeta que recibía mensajes de Dios). Roboam y Jeroboam estuvieron siempre en guerra el uno contra el otro.

fr.L: Et les actes de Roboam, les premiers et les derniers, ne sont-ils pas écrits dans les paroles de Shemaya le prophète et d’Iddo le voyant, pour l’enregistrement généalogique ? Et [il y eut] des guerres entre Roboam et Jéroboam tous les jours.
fr.B: Les actes de Roboam, du premier au dernier, sont écrits dans les récits de Shemaya le prophète et d’Iddo le voyant, dans les registres généalogiques. Il y eut sans cesse des guerres entre Roboam et Jéroboam.
fr.R: Tout ce que Roboam a fait, du début à la fin, a été écrit dans les récits du prophète Shemaya et du voyant Iddo, dans les registres des familles. (Un voyant était un prophète qui recevait des messages de Dieu.) Roboam et Jéroboam ont toujours été en guerre l’un contre l’autre.

sw.L: Na mambo ya Rehoboamu, ya kwanza na ya mwisho, je, hayajaandikwa katika maneno ya Shemaya nabii na ya Ido mwonaji, kwa kuandikishwa kwa koo? Na [kulikuwa na] vita vya Rehoboamu na Yeroboamu siku zote.
sw.B: Mambo ya Rehoboamu, tangu mwanzo hadi mwisho, yameandikwa katika kumbukumbu za Shemaya nabii na za Ido mwonaji, katika orodha za koo. Kulikuwa na vita kati ya Rehoboamu na Yeroboamu daima.
sw.R: Kila kitu alichofanya Rehoboamu, tangu mwanzo hadi mwisho, kimeandikwa katika kumbukumbu za Shemaya nabii na Ido mwonaji, katika orodha za koo. (Mwonaji alikuwa nabii aliyepokea ujumbe kutoka kwa Mungu.) Rehoboamu na Yeroboamu walikuwa vitani wao kwa wao wakati wote.

vi.L: Các việc của Rô-bô-am, từ đầu đến cuối, chẳng phải đã được chép trong lời của nhà tiên tri Sê-ma-gia và của nhà tiên kiến Y-đô, theo cách ghi gia phả sao? Giữa Rô-bô-am và Giê-rô-bô-am có chiến tranh mọi ngày.
vi.B: Các việc của Rô-bô-am, từ đầu đến cuối, đều được chép trong sách ghi chép của nhà tiên tri Sê-ma-gia và của nhà tiên kiến Y-đô, trong phần gia phả. Giữa Rô-bô-am và Giê-rô-bô-am luôn có chiến tranh.
vi.R: Mọi việc Rô-bô-am đã làm, từ đầu đến cuối, đều được chép trong sách ghi chép của nhà tiên tri Sê-ma-gia và nhà tiên kiến Y-đô, trong phần ghi gia phả. (Nhà tiên kiến là nhà tiên tri nhận sứ điệp từ Đức Chúa Trời.) Rô-bô-am và Giê-rô-bô-am luôn đánh nhau.

ko.L: 그리고 르호보암의 일들은 처음부터 끝까지 예언자 스마야와 선견자 잇도의 말들 가운데 족보에 따라 기록되어 있지 않으냐? 그리고 르호보암과 여로보암 사이에 모든 날 동안 전쟁이 있었다.
ko.B: 르호보암의 행적은 처음부터 끝까지 예언자 스마야와 선견자 잇도의 기록 가운데 족보에 기록되어 있다. 르호보암과 여로보암 사이에는 늘 전쟁이 있었다.
ko.R: 르호보암이 한 모든 일은 처음부터 끝까지 예언자 스마야와 선견자 잇도의 기록 가운데 집안 족보에 기록되어 있다. (선견자는 하나님께서 말씀을 보여 주시는 예언자이다.) 르호보암과 여로보암은 내내 서로 싸웠다.

pt.L: E os atos de Roboão, os primeiros e os últimos, não estão escritos nas palavras de Semaías, o profeta, e de Ido, o vidente, para o registro genealógico? E [houve] guerras de Roboão e Jeroboão todos os dias.
pt.B: Os atos de Roboão, do primeiro ao último, estão escritos nos registros de Semaías, o profeta, e de Ido, o vidente, nas listas genealógicas. Houve guerras entre Roboão e Jeroboão durante todo o tempo deles.
pt.R: Tudo o que Roboão fez, do começo ao fim, está escrito nos registros de Semaías, o profeta, e de Ido, o vidente, nas listas das famílias. (Um vidente era um profeta que recebia mensagens de Deus.) Roboão e Jeroboão estavam sempre em guerra um contra o outro.

decisions.choice: the sources named: the words of Shemaiah and Iddo instead of the royal record
decisions.reason: 1 Kings 14:29 points to "the book of the matters of the days of the kings of Judah". Chronicles points instead to the writings of two prophets, as it does for David and Solomon (1 Chronicles 29:29; 2 Chronicles 9:29). The Hebrew word for "matters" and for "words" is the same, so the line plays on it: the matters of Rehoboam are in the words of the prophets. These writings have not survived.

decisions.choice: for genealogical enrollment: the writings included genealogical records
decisions.reason: The phrase is short and unclear. It may mean the prophets' writings were arranged with genealogical lists, or that Rehoboam's family (11:18-23) was recorded there. Some think the words are out of place in the sentence. The Hebrew is kept as it stands.

decisions.choice: the seer: a prophet who sees visions
decisions.reason: "Seer" is an older name for a prophet, one who "sees" what Yahweh shows him (1 Samuel 9:9). Iddo is also named as a source for Solomon (9:29) and Abijah (13:22).

decisions.choice: wars of Rehoboam and Jeroboam all the days: as 1 Kings 14:30, in the plural
decisions.reason: 1 Kings 14:30 says "there was war between Rehoboam and Jeroboam all the days". Chronicles has "wars" and joins the sentence to the source note. It means repeated fighting throughout both reigns, though Rehoboam had been told not to fight to win back the north (11:4).

decisions.choice: are they not written ...?: a question expecting "yes"
decisions.reason: As in Kings, the question means "they are written there" and points the reader to the source.

decisions.choice: a statement instead of a question (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: As for every use of this formula: the question stays at Literal and becomes a statement at Balanced and Readable. "Records" at Balanced and Readable renders the Hebrew "words", meaning their written accounts.

decisions.choice: continually (Balanced); always (Readable)
decisions.reason: "All the days" means all through their reigns.

decisions.choice: (A seer was a prophet who received messages from God.)
decisions.reason: Readable explains "seer" the first time it comes in a chapter (m3).

decisions.choice: the source formula: a question at Literal, a statement at Balanced and Readable
decisions.reason: As the Kings terms note sets for Spanish, with the prophets' writings Chronicles names, as in 9:29.

decisions.choice: A question at Literal, a statement at Balanced and Readable; "스마야와 잇도의 말들" (L), "기록" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The source formula of the terms note in Chronicles' pattern (m1).

decisions.choice: nas palavras de (L), nos registros de (B, R); Semaías, o profeta; Ido, o vidente
decisions.reason: The prophets' records are "as palavras de" at Literal, keeping the one Hebrew word, and "os registros de" at Balanced and Readable, as the English says "records" and as 9:29 has them in Portuguese (1 Chronicles 29:29 says "crônicas" at Balanced; "registros" keeps them apart from the royal Book of the Chronicles), with "Semaías, o profeta" and "Ido, o vidente" (m1, m3). The source note is a question at Literal and a statement at Balanced and Readable, as the English (r-en-1); "guerras" is plural, where 1 Kings 14:30 has "guerra" (m4). Readable explains "vidente" with the words of 1 Chronicles 25:5.

records.literal_gloss: And lay down Rehoboam with his fathers and was buried in [the] city of David; and reigned Abijah his son in his place.

en.L: And Rehoboam lay down with his fathers and was buried in the City of David. And Abijah his son reigned in his place.
en.B: Rehoboam rested with his ancestors and was buried in the City of David. His son Abijah became king in his place.
en.R: Rehoboam died and was buried in the City of David. His son Abijah became king after him.

es.L: Y durmió Roboam con sus padres y fue sepultado en la ciudad de David. Y reinó en su lugar Abías su hijo.
es.B: Roboam descansó con sus antepasados y fue sepultado en la ciudad de David. Su hijo Abías reinó en su lugar.
es.R: Roboam murió y fue sepultado en la ciudad de David. Su hijo Abías lo sucedió como rey.

fr.L: Et Roboam se coucha avec ses pères et fut enterré dans la cité de David. Et Abiya son fils régna à sa place.
fr.B: Roboam reposa avec ses ancêtres et fut enterré dans la cité de David. Et Abiya son fils régna à sa place.
fr.R: Roboam est mort et il a été enterré dans la cité de David. Son fils Abiya est devenu roi à sa place.

sw.L: Rehoboamu akalala pamoja na baba zake, akazikwa katika mji wa Daudi. Na Abiya mwanawe akatawala mahali pake.
sw.B: Rehoboamu akapumzika pamoja na babu zake, akazikwa katika mji wa Daudi. Na mwanawe Abiya akawa mfalme mahali pake.
sw.R: Rehoboamu akafa, akazikwa katika mji wa Daudi. Na mwanawe Abiya akawa mfalme mahali pake.

vi.L: Rô-bô-am nằm xuống với tổ phụ mình và được chôn trong thành Đa-vít; A-bi-gia con trai ông trị vì thay ông.
vi.B: Rô-bô-am an giấc cùng tổ tiên và được chôn trong thành Đa-vít. A-bi-gia con trai vua lên kế vị.
vi.R: Rô-bô-am qua đời và được chôn trong thành Đa-vít. A-bi-gia con trai vua lên kế vị.

ko.L: 그리고 르호보암이 그의 조상들과 함께 누웠고, 다윗 성에 묻혔다. 그리고 그의 아들 아비야가 그를 대신하여 왕이 되었다.
ko.B: 르호보암은 조상들과 함께 잠들었고, 다윗 성에 묻혔다. 그의 아들 아비야가 뒤를 이어 왕이 되었다.

pt.L: E Roboão descansou com os seus pais e foi sepultado na Cidade de Davi. E Abias, seu filho, reinou em seu lugar.
pt.B: Roboão descansou com os seus antepassados e foi sepultado na Cidade de Davi. E o seu filho Abias reinou em seu lugar.
pt.R: Roboão morreu e foi sepultado na Cidade de Davi. O seu filho Abias se tornou rei depois dele.

decisions.choice: the close of 1 Kings 14:31, shortened
decisions.reason: 1 Kings 14:31 says Rehoboam was buried "with his fathers" and repeats his mother's name. Chronicles leaves both out. Kings calls his son Abijam; Chronicles calls him Abijah (13:1). It is the same king.

decisions.choice: lay down with his fathers: died
decisions.reason: The death formula, as in 9:31: he died and joined his ancestors.

decisions.choice: lay down with his fathers / rested with his ancestors / died
decisions.reason: The death formula as worded throughout Kings and Chronicles.

decisions.choice: "Abías"
decisions.reason: Chronicles calls the son Abijah where 1 Kings 14:31 has Abijam (meaning decision); Spanish keeps the form each book uses, as the Kings terms note sets.

decisions.choice: "se coucha avec ses pères" (L), "reposa avec ses ancêtres" (B), "est mort" (R); "et Abiya son fils régna à sa place" (R "son fils Abiya est devenu roi à sa place")
decisions.reason: The death and successor formulas of the terms note, as in French Kings; Chronicles calls the son Abiya where Kings has Abiyam.

decisions.choice: Abiya
decisions.reason: Chronicles calls Rehoboam's son Abijah where 1 Kings 14:31 says Abijam; Swahili keeps each book's form, as the terms note sets.

decisions.choice: the death formula of 1 Kings 14:31, shortened; Abias (Abiam in Kings)
alternatives: foi sepultado com os seus pais; Abiam
decisions.reason: The death formula keeps the Portuguese of 1 Kings 14:31 at each level, without "com os seus pais" after "sepultado" and the mother's name, which Chronicles leaves out (m1). The son is "Abias", as Chronicles names him; Kings in Portuguese calls the same king "Abiam" (11:20).
